title: Money, Coins, and Wages
summary: Biblical money references include coins, weights, wages, debts, tribute, and measures that may not match modern economic assumptions.
background: Understanding ordinary wages and coinage helps with parables about laborers, debts, taxes, generosity, stewardship, and injustice.
teachingHelp: Avoid forcing exact modern dollar equivalents. Explain the relative value, social setting, and point of the passage.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (1874 / early public-domain editions).
International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
